tasks.title: Polish: gold vault launcher icon, empty states and accessibility
tasks.prompt:
Continue the Tijori React Native app. This is a polish task.

Task:
1. Replace the default React Native launcher icon with a simple, tasteful gold vault mark for Tijori. Produce the mipmap PNGs for every density plus the round variants (mdpi, hdpi, xhdpi, xxhdpi, xxxhdpi), drawn on the app's off-white background using the app's gold accent. Keep it simple and flat: a rounded vault or safe shape with a dial. Generate the images locally in the repository (for example with a small Python script using Pillow) - do not call any external image service.
2. Add proper empty states to the list screens (Passwords, Birthdays, Notes, Cards, Documents): a short message and a hint to add the first item, matching the existing visual language.
3. Add accessibility labels to the icon-only buttons and the tab bar items so screen readers describe them properly.

Keep the existing visual language and keep the change additive.

Housekeeping: do not commit any temporary or patch files (.diff, .patch, .orig, .rej, .bak or editor backups), and do not leave reasoning or thinking-out-loud comments in the code.

Constraints: TypeScript; npm run typecheck, npm run lint and npm test must pass; do not add new dependencies.

tasks.title: Documents: expiry dates, expiring soon, and document packs
tasks.prompt:
Continue the Tijori React Native app. Build on the existing Documents section (src/DocumentsScreen.tsx, src/DocumentSheet.tsx, src/storage/) - it is already in the repository, so read it first and extend it rather than recreating it.

Task:
1. Give each document an optional expiry date, using a date picker (reuse src/Calendar.tsx).
2. Add an 'Expiring soon' section at the top of the Documents screen listing documents expiring within the next 90 days, with the number of days remaining. No push notifications.
3. Add document packs: a small set of ready-made checklists (for example Passport application, Bank KYC, Driving licence) showing which required document types the user already has and which are missing. A pack is satisfied when every required type is present.
4. Add unit tests for any new storage logic.

Keep the existing visual language, keep the change additive, and do not restructure shared files more than is strictly necessary.

Housekeeping: do not commit any temporary or patch files (.diff, .patch, .orig, .rej, .bak or editor backups), and do not leave reasoning or thinking-out-loud comments in the code.

Constraints: TypeScript; npm run typecheck, npm run lint and npm test must pass; do not add new dependencies.
